A '''tosser''' was an [[Athlete/Legends|athlete]] that played the game of [[ringers]]. During the game, the individual athletes were designated numerically on the scoreboard, such as [[Tosser Three]] and [[Tosser Five]].<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>
